task: You have one email list of 40,000 subscribers for a home-fitness equipment brand, with no segmentation applied yet. Propose 3 real, actionable segments (not generic 'age 25-34' demographic buckets) based on behavior you'd realistically have (purchase history, email engagement, site activity), and one distinct message angle per segment.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) all 3 segments are behavior-based (e.g. 'purchased once, no repeat in 90 days' or 'opens every email, never clicks'), not demographic buckets; (b) each segment maps to a message angle that would plausibly differ from the others -- not the same generic message repeated 3 times; (c) segments are realistic given only the stated data (purchase history, email engagement, site activity) -- doesn't invent data sources not given.
